notes: Sourced from BSS Audio's own product page (bssaudio.com/en-US/products/blu-100) and its linked official datasheet (Cut Sheet 18-0717-B) and Install Guide (rear-panel diagram), both served from bssaudio.com's document host (adn.harmanpro.com — BSS Audio's parent, Harman Professional). The datasheet's technical-specifications table explicitly confirms all analog I/O as "Phoenix/Combicon removable screw connectors," control I/O and watchdog as Phoenix/Combicon, BLU link and control network as RJ45, and mains as 100–240V AC/50–60Hz. Grades were omitted for the RJ45 Ethernet control port and both BLU link ports because the datasheet states cable type/length and latency but never an explicit Ethernet speed (BLU link is BSS's proprietary digital-audio-bus protocol over Cat5e, not standard graded Ethernet). The AC inlet's exact IEC sub-type (C13/C14) is inferred from the rear-panel photo rather than stated in text. Physical I/O is grouped by the physical connector blocks silkscreened on the rear panel (INPUTS split into blocks A/B/C of 4 channels each; OUTPUTS split into blocks D/E of 4 channels each) rather than broken out per individual channel, since each lettered block is one pluggable terminal-block connector.

ports.name: Input A
ports.note: Analog mic/line inputs 1–4 of 12, on Phoenix/Combicon removable screw terminal block; software gain to +48dB in 6dB steps, 48V phantom power switchable per channel

ports.name: Output D
ports.note: Analog outputs 1–4 of 8, on Phoenix/Combicon removable screw terminal block

ports.name: Control
ports.note: GPIO terminal block: 12 control inputs (0–4.5V) plus 6 logic outputs (0/+5V, 10mA source/60mA sink) for third-party control system integration

ports.name: Watchdog
ports.note: Dedicated Phoenix/Combicon opto-relay output for failsafe/rack-controller integration

ports.name: RS232
ports.note: Serial control port (DE9 per rear-panel diagram)

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: HiQnet control network port for HiQnet London Architect; Cat5 cabling, 100m max, no link speed stated in datasheet so grade omitted

ports.name: BLU link In
ports.note: One of two ports for the proprietary 48-channel, low-latency, fault-tolerant digital audio bus (daisy-chain up to 60 nodes), Cat5e, 100m between devices; proprietary protocol, not standard graded Ethernet, so grade omitted

ports.name: BLU link Out
ports.note: Second BLU link port for daisy-chaining to the next device

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: 100–240V AC, 50/60Hz, <55VA (<188 BTU/hr); standard IEC inlet visible in rear-panel photo — exact connector sub-type (C13/C14) not spelled out in the text spec table, so inferred from imagery
